summary: The StudentPREvaluations system handles the creation, updating, deletion, and retrieval of student pre-evaluation records. It is structured to interact with a SQL database using various procedures to manage these records.
purpose: Manage student pre-evaluation records within the HSPnet system, enabling operations like add, update, delete, and search for evaluation data.

workflows.name: Add Student Pre-Evaluation
steps: Add parameters: SessionID, StudentID, PlacementRequestDestinationID, RequirementCodeID, StatusCodeID, EvaluationDate, Comment.

workflows.name: Update Student Pre-Evaluation
steps: Add parameters: SessionID, ID, RequirementCodeID, StatusCodeID, EvaluationDate, Comment.

business_rules: PlacementRequestDestinationID must not be 0 for adding records.

calculations.name: EvaluationDateFormatted
calculations.formula: If EvaluationDate is null, return empty; otherwise, format using HSPnet.UI.DateFormatter.FormatDateShort.

conditions: Check if ID is not 0 for searching by ID.
system_behavior: Interacts with the database to execute stored procedures for managing student pre-evaluations.
